report.summary: The `catch` branch of `load()` in `public/src/store.js` set `orders: []` on every failure, so a failed Refresh wiped the list. I removed that reset. A failed load now only sets `loading: false` and the error message, so the orders on screen stay and "Could not refresh orders." is shown (ORD-3). Switching filters still clears the previous list, so one filter's rows never show under another (ORD-2). A failed first load still says "Could not load orders." (ORD-5), and the next successful refresh still clears the message. I also added a regression test in `test/store.test.js`.
report.verification: `npm test` passes (5 of 5), including the new test. It loads two orders, makes a refresh fail, and checks the error text and that both orders remain. It then lets a refresh succeed and checks the message is cleared and the orders are still there. I did not drive the page in a browser.
